title: devexp-standup-2026-05-20
content:
Attendees: Priya, Marco, Samira, Ben, several async updates from others (see thread).

Quick summary: focus this week on SDK v1.4 stabilization (streaming + reconnect fixes), finish two quickstarts (Next.js sample + Python CLI), and update getting-started docs for function-calling changes.

Notes / updates by area:
- SDKs (Priya)
  - Merged core changes for streaming reconnect backoff (PR #478). Running full integration tests on staging; found intermittent 502s when switching model variants under load.
  - Packaging bug: wheel includes old vendored dependency (reported in #482). Hotfix branch open, aiming to ship patch by Fri 2026-05-22.
  - Action: follow up with infra about stable staging keys for SDK CI (assigned to Priya, due 2026-05-21).

- Docs (Marco)
  - Draft of function calling migration guide ready; posted to Confluence for review. Need SME review for edge cases (nested args, unknown fields).
  - Updated quickstart index page with clearer TL;DRs and added code snippets for Java + Node.
  - Blocking: need final SDK patch to update code examples that reference streaming API surface (blocks DOCS-223).
  - Action: Marco to file a small doc PR once SDK patch is cut (target Mon 2026-05-25).

- Samples & Quickstarts (Samira)
  - Next.js sample app: basic auth + streaming demo wired; still failing on incremental hydration when chunk size > 512 tokens (likely client-side issue).
  - Python CLI quickstart: PR opened, awaiting review from Ben (https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/91).
  - Added a minimal embedding sample that shows caching of embeddings for a small FAQ bot.

- Demos / QA (Ben)
  - Running manual playthroughs for hosted API flows; hit a regression with multipart/form-data uploads for attachments (file size handling). Filed a Jira: API-517.
  - Verified that dedicated customers on v1 have no regressions so far. Need to expand smoke tests to include function calling payloads.

Risks / Blockers:
- Streaming reconnect bug under load: could affect production streaming demos. High priority for SDK hotfix.
- Doc examples are blocked by SDK patch (DOCS-223).
- Staging CI instability due to ephemeral key rotation delaying some integration tests.

Decisions/Calls made in meeting:
- Ship SDK v1.4.1 hotfix (no new features) if packaging or 502 issues reproduce in next 24h.
- Defer Next.js sample advanced hydration optimization to after quickstart launch; ship minimal working sample first.

Action items (owner - due):
- Priya: cut hotfix branch and coordinate staging keys with infra (2026-05-21).
- Marco: open docs PR for function-calling migration once SDK patch available (2026-05-25).
- Samira: address Next.js chunking fallback and re-run demo tests (2026-05-24).
- Ben: review Python CLI sample PR and add smoke tests for function-calling (2026-05-22).
- All: add any missing test cases to the quickstarts test matrix (quickstarts-tests.md) before merge.

Notes to self / follow-ups:
- Check with SRE on Wednesday about load testing windows for streaming reconnect scenarios.
- Consider a short compatibility note for Dedicated customers if we need a rolling restart to fix streaming bug.

Meeting adjourned — next standup: 2026-05-27.

Informal/working notes (scratchpad):
- if streaming reconnect persists, maybe swap reconcile logic to use new token-based session ids — idea to prototype.
- Quick wins: add a small troubleshooting section in quickstarts for common CORS / hydration issues (saves time during demos).

References / links mentioned during standup:
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/478
- Samples PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/91
- Jira: DOCS-223, API-517
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DEVEXP/quickstarts-index
